episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Having devoted most of her life to her career, Ui-yeong is determined to find her other half.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As days pass without hearing from Tae-seop, Ui-yeong decides to go on another blind date.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A drunken Ui-yeong signs herself up for a series of blind dates on an impulse.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Work brings Ui-yeong and Tae-seop together again, but things take a turn.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Ui-yeong and Tae-seop continue to grow closer, but an incident at work causes a misunderstanding.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Ui-yeong wakes up to a startling sight and is assigned to manage protocol for a famous actress' stay.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: An unexpected guest interrupts Ui-yeong's date with Tae-seop. Meanwhile, Ji-su disappears and Ui-yeong tracks him down.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Ui-yeong finds herself torn between the two men but soon realizes her true feelings.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: As her new relationship blossoms, Ui-yeong is caught in a predicament.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Ui-yeong decides to go on a vacation, but her peace is disrupted when an unexpected visitor arrives.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: A heated argument with her mother arises, leaving Ui-yeong feeling disappointed.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Ui-yeong reflects on what marriage means to her and contemplates what her future may hold.
